title: Russia Offers NATO Non-Aggression Pacts. In 1939 It Signed One With Hitler #shorts
description:
This week a Russian diplomat said Moscow could conclude non-aggression pacts with NATO member states. In August 1939 the Soviet Union signed a non-aggression pact with Nazi Germany; within weeks both armies invaded Poland, and in June 1941 Hitler broke the pact.
